description: This file defines the AlarmAdapter class, which serves as an adapter for a RecyclerView displaying scheduled alarms. It manages the list of alarms, binds alarm data to views, handles alarm deletion, and provides item decorations for the RecyclerView.

classes.name: AlarmAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class for managing and displaying alarms in a RecyclerView.

classes.name: AlarmViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder class that holds references to views for individual alarm items.

classes.name: SortedListCallback
classes.description: Callback class for handling changes in the SortedList of alarms.

classes.name: DividerItemDecoration
classes.description: A RecyclerView.ItemDecoration that draws divider lines between alarm items.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the alarm item layout and creates a new AlarmViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds alarm data to the view holder and sets up the delete button click listener.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of alarms in the list.

methods.name: addAlarm
methods.description: Adds a new alarm to the list and notifies the adapter.

methods.name: deleteAlarm
methods.description: Removes an alarm from the list and updates the view.
